text: Ernest Hemingway's For Whom the Bell Tolls was first published in English in 1940, but in Spain censors prohibited its publication until 1968. That year a censored Spanish translation appeared under the title Por quién doblan las campanas.
meta_description: For Whom the Bell Tolls by Ernest Hemingway: Spanish censors prohibited publication until 1968, when a censored translation appeared.
changes: Leads with author and title; adds the 1940 English edition from the source; two events in order.
